title: Glowing hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon envelope -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='26' ry='28' fill='#ff4b5c'/>
  <!-- balloon vertical stripes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='35' rx='9' ry='28' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='35' rx='9' ry='28' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='6' ry='28' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- balloon bottom curve -->
  <path d='M34 55 Q50 70 66 55' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- glow highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='25' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- ropes -->
  <line x1='38' y1='60' x2='43' y2='72' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='60' x2='57' y2='72' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='63' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- basket -->
  <rect x='41' y='72' width='18' height='13' rx='2' fill='#c77d3a'/>
  <rect x='41' y='72' width='18' height='4' rx='1' fill='#e0a96d'/>
  <rect x='43' y='80' width='14' height='1.5' fill='#a55a25'/>
  <!-- burner glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='69' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='69' r='1.5' fill='#fff7cc'/>
  <!-- little stars / glow bits -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='15' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='20' r='1' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
